brain.commentary: Risk-on backdrop is tempered by weak composites, limited alpha, and meaningful downside tails in BTC/ETH/SOL. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal, but overall conviction does not justify full risk. LTC is notably fragile. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC show identical fallback metrics with zero volatility, expected shortfall, liquidity, and institutional data; their long signals are therefore unvalidated and should be heavily discounted.
